title: Ansatsu Kyoushitsu: episode:0 Deai no Jikan
justification: AniList 21303 (SPECIAL, 1 episode from 2014-11-09, 10 min) is AniDB 10702's special S1 Deai no Jikan (Meeting Time), aired 2014-11-09. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 20755, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 10702, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji and English titles (Deai no Jikan, Meeting Time). The parent's row places S1 on TVDB 0x2 Episode 0 "Meeting Time" (2014-11-09) and, by default, on TMDB 62110 S0E1 Episode 0 - Meeting Time (2014-11-09). The recorded collision with AniDB 9985 at S0E1 is gone: overlay/9985.json already clears that node's TMDB values.
